capabilities: parse tar or gzip tar Lakebook archives
convert HTML headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and Lake cards to Markdown
rebuild folder hierarchy from tocYml parent-child relations
download remote images to the attachment folder with fallback links
generate an import report and preserve original document JSON
extras: Not submitted to the official community plugin directory; manual installation from release files. Desktop only (Obsidian 1.5.0+). Chinese-language README with English release notes. Limits documented: 512 MB unpack cap, 100 MB per image, unsupported cards and complex layouts may not convert fully.
problem: Obsidian cannot read Yuque's proprietary .lakebook export format, so migrating a Yuque knowledge base into Markdown requires manual conversion.
summary: Imports Yuque Lakebook (.lakebook) export archives as Markdown notes with folders, images, link conversion, and original document JSON.
